key_insight: Reasoning-Trace Analysis makes LLM-generated Q-matrix assignments inspectable, revealing disagreements that matrix-level agreement and fit alone miss.
engineering_relevance: The framework offers an audit layer for AI-assisted diagnostic assessment design, supplementing expert review and empirical validation.
method: Prompt LLMs to generate attribute-labeled reasoning steps for each item.
Reconstruct Q-matrix assignments from the generated traces.
Compare matrices and inspect traces to identify sources of disagreement.
evidence_signal: Across 11 fraction-subtraction items, responses from 536 examinees, four LLMs, and 100 replications per condition, trace-derived matrices had lower mean reference overlap than directly generated matrices (.809 vs .877) and greater variability.
watch_item: Generated traces are inspectable outputs, not verified explanations of model internals; attribute-labeling rules and step formulation can affect assignments.
paper_title: Reasoning-Trace Analysis Using Large Language Models for Interpretable Q-Matrix Construction
